decision: Do not integrate: JSON runtime improvement is small, while repeatable large incremental-append workload regresses materially.

implementation.description: Private MkSb adds trailing flexible MkChar storage for 16 UTF-16 units; mk_sb_new allocates sizeof(MkSb)+32 bytes with mk_alloc_sized and initial capacity 16. Growth above inline storage allocates and copies used chars; subsequent growth uses realloc; dispose frees only heap storage. TypeInfo instance_size and existing field offsets are retained; toString always copies.
